overview: Dialectica is a B2B information services firm founded in 2015, with its first offices in London and Athens. The company combines custom expert recruitment with surveys, written research, company intelligence and senior-advisor searches. In its July 9, 2025 anniversary announcement, Dialectica reported annual revenue exceeding $100 million. It now reports more than 1,600 employees and describes Dialectica IQ as the knowledge graph behind its products. Its March 2026 announcement reports a sixth consecutive FT1000 appearance and over $30 million invested in AI and technology during the preceding three years. Origin now documents embedded interview transcripts and an MCP connector for searching and synthesizing research inside AI tools.

history.narrative: Dialectica was co-founded in 2015 by George Tsarouchas and Frederick Corkett. Its About page identifies Tsarouchas as CEO and Corkett as Managing Director, and records its first offices in London and Athens, its Montreal opening in 2020 and New York opening in 2021. The company reported annual revenue exceeding $100 million in its July 9, 2025 anniversary announcement. Its March 2026 announcement reports its sixth consecutive inclusion in the FT1000.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Calls
servicesDetailed.description: One-on-one consultations with custom-sourced experts. Dialectica says over 65% of call expert profiles are first-time, custom-recruited professionals. Its corporate offering includes AI-powered call transcripts and executive summaries.

servicesDetailed.name: B2B Surveys
servicesDetailed.description: End-to-end B2B surveys covering custom respondent recruitment, questionnaire design, programming, fieldwork and live results. Dialectica describes use cases including customer research, competitive benchmarking, pricing strategy and due diligence. Respondents can be selected for follow-up calls.

servicesDetailed.name: Insights (Written Reports)
servicesDetailed.description: Bespoke written research for market sizing, competitive positioning, customer insights and M&A target assessment. Dialectica says its team combines expert interviews, public sources and internal data, and describes a 3–5 business-day turnaround for requested company reports.

servicesDetailed.name: Origin (Company & Market Intelligence)
servicesDetailed.description: A deal-screening and company intelligence platform aimed at private equity teams. Dialectica describes expert-derived company profiles, embedded interview transcripts, target search and personalized deal alerts. Its MCP connector provides cited research within Claude and other compatible clients.

servicesDetailed.name: Executive Partnerships
servicesDetailed.description: Senior-advisor and chair searches for deal origination, due diligence and portfolio-company work. Dialectica describes tailored candidate profiles, introductory calls and ongoing advisor introductions.

servicesDetailed.name: Dialectica IQ (Knowledge Graph)
servicesDetailed.description: Dialectica describes IQ as the knowledge graph behind its products. Its platform page lists 80M company and market records, 1M expert conversations and a community of 750,000 experts. These are company-stated scale figures, rather than independently audited counts.

aiPlatform.narrative: Dialectica says its AI infrastructure combines the Dialectica IQ knowledge graph, more than 50 GenAI tools, proprietary AI agents and datasets enriched by a 1,000+ operations team. Its homepage lists 120+ technology and data professionals. In March 2026, it reported investing over $30M in AI and technology during the preceding three years. Its public product pages describe AI-powered transcripts and executive summaries, while Origin documents cited synthesis and transcript search through an MCP connector. These descriptions establish the advertised capabilities; they do not independently validate research quality or performance.

AI-powered call transcripts and executive summaries

complianceExtended.narrative: Dialectica announced Jason Howard as Chief Legal & Regulatory Officer on January 30, 2025, responsible for legal, compliance and Global Client Protection. The announcement says he previously spent nearly five years as General Counsel and Chief Compliance Officer at Tegus and over 13 years in the SEC Division of Enforcement. Dialectica describes expert screening and compliance review of Origin content. A Persona customer case study describes identity verification integrated into Dialectica workflows and tailored to client requirements; it presents verification of the entire network as a goal, rather than a completed rollout.
highlights: Jason Howard appointment and remit documented in Dialectica’s January 2025 announcement
Origin content reviewed for relevance, quality and compliance, according to Dialectica
Persona case study describes configurable identity checks alongside manual expert screening
B2B Surveys page describes SurveyGuard anti-fraud checks and response-quality monitoring

clientFit.narrative: Editorial assessment based on the advertised services: Dialectica is a fit to evaluate for private equity target screening, consulting research and corporate strategy work combining calls, surveys and bespoke reports. Origin is relevant to teams seeking company intelligence, interview transcripts and research within existing AI tools. Pricing and capability requirements should be checked against a service-specific proposal.

strengths: Custom recruitment: Dialectica says over 65% of call expert profiles are first-time recruits
Company-reported AI and technology investment of over $30M during the three years preceding March 2026

caveats: Expert-community size, staffing, AI investment and research-performance descriptions are company-stated figures
No client per-call price was verified; the corporate page describes packages and pay-as-you-go agreements
A full audit trail for every expert interaction and a standard cooling-off period were not established by the public sources reviewed
Origin’s MCP landing page marks project launch and interactive cards as coming soon, while its documentation also describes those workflows; confirm availability for the intended account
Persona’s case study describes full-network identity verification as a goal, so it should not be assumed for every expert
